summary: Every Card Library and Deck Builder filter is now an include/exclude check-box group (checked = included, unchecked = excluded, all start checked) with Select all / Deselect all. Gold cost, Printing set, Collection drop-downs and the Entire catalogue / Playable now buttons become check lists; clans, Types, Keywords, Focus Value and Action Type use the same model; the tag row shows one removable tag per active filter. New filters default to FilterChecklist.
validation: dotnet build of src/L5R.Client succeeded (0 warnings); native Godot probes run on this Windows machine: CatalogueProbe (CATALOGUE PASS), DeckBuilderProbe (DECK BUILDER PASS), MyCollectionProbe (COLLECTION NATIVE PASS: 35 assertions); probes rewritten for the new semantics; captures clans-filter and sets inspected. check.sh --skip-client not run (no Core change).
remaining: Gold cost trigger sits tight against Support in the filter row; Mendon to eyeball. Multi-valued features (keywords, types, sets) keep a card while ANY of its features is checked; exclusion-wins is the alternative if preferred.
